scope: Curated historical measurements, not a rerun on the GitHub documentation commit. See TESTING.en.md for limitations.

limitations: Basic uses its native physical-capacity threshold; budgets are not directly comparable. No cost superiority claim.

engineReuse.scope: Reused 27-sample model, recovery, scale and UI engine evidence applies to byte-identical engine/runtime/type/dependency files.
